definitions.gloss: looking around restlessly; glancing about nervously
definitions.explanation: Describes the action of repeatedly looking in different directions, typically out of curiosity, confusion, or nervousness.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}に{迷|まよ}ってきょろきょろ{見回|みまわ}した。
examples.english: I was lost and looked around restlessly.

examples.japanese: きょろきょろしないで{前|まえ}を{向|む}いて。
examples.english: Stop looking around and face forward.

examples.japanese: {観光客|かんこうきゃく}がきょろきょろと{辺|あた}りを{見回|みまわ}している。
examples.english: The tourists are glancing around at their surroundings.

notes:
MIMETIC TYPE:
Onomatopoeia describing eye movement - the sound/feel of eyes darting around.

GRAMMATICAL FORMS:
・きょろきょろ（と）{見|み}る - to look around restlessly
・きょろきょろする - to glance about (suru-verb)
・きょろきょろ{見回|みまわ}す - to look all around

NUANCE:
Often implies the person looks uncertain, lost, or unfamiliar with their surroundings. Can have a slightly comic or childlike connotation.

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・ちらちら{見|み}る - to glance repeatedly (more subtle)
・じろじろ{見|み}る - to stare intently (rude)
・うろうろする - to wander about aimlessly
